rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.requirement: Housing providers receiving DND funding or land, or with BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units, may not use blanket bans based on arrests or convictions and must not consider non-conviction arrests, convictions with judicial relief, juvenile records, or convictions more than 5 years old. They also may not use credit scores to approve or deny applications, and may use credit history only in lieu of rental history.
rules.key_value: No consideration of convictions more than 5 years old; no credit score use
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, February 2017)
rules.status_basis: Policy dated February 2017; adoption date not stated.

requires.name: dnd_funded_or_inclusionary_income_restricted
requires.text: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy

coverage.summary: Applies to housing providers with DND funding or land, or BPDA inclusionary income-restricted units.
coverage.exemptions_summary: The criminal-history rules do not apply where a conviction directly relates to the housing sought, poses unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, or involves current criminal behavior.

precedence.text: Where federal or state law imposes a criminal history requirement that conflicts with a requirement of this guidance, the federal or state law preempts this policy.
